profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Capital One | Speaker | Frontend Leader
profile.summary:
I am a senior software engineer, full stack web developer, mostly specializing in designing and building highly scalable and great user experiences for customers. I love JavaScript and use all major frontend frameworks and libraries like Lit Element, Angular, React, and Vue. For API Development I have the most experience working with Node/Express, but I have built very performant BFFs and APIs using Java+Spring Boot. I have extensive experience working in a microservice architected environment with distributed systems and multiple dev layers. I also have cross-platform development experience with React Native, Ionic, and minimal experience Vue Native. 

I think outside the box and solve problems starting with the customer first. I have a strong design focus, and work very closely with designers to build amazing applications and user experiences someone will definitely enjoy.

I have experience utilizing Web Assembly (WASM) and Workers with MFEs deploying into production environments utilizing the browser for an amazing browser experience in a frontend application. I have compiled C++ apps into a WASM target for a browser to consume and allow the browser to have desktop like experiences in a web setting.

I have built out and maintained our pipeline flow utilizing Gitflow as a branching strategy and CI/CD deployment using Jenkins and Bamboo. 

Application Architecture is important to me -- if the application is not properly architected and planned out, the software could be deemed as not maintainable. I strive to give the best advice possible when walking into an existing application or designing a new application from scratch about how it should be designed. I see things abstractly and have been told I have a keen eye for UI/UX design from a development standpoint, tying it into the current plan for how an app is being developed.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
In financial services I work as a frontend lead engineer in auto refinance, developing and architecting our one agent platform. As the lead engineer, I mentor other developers, work directly with Experience Design and Product Management, and build amazing experiences for people to interact with. I build MFEs utilizing Lit Element and custom web components, Angular, and building our shared component library for our agent platform that all developers use as their single source of truth for web components to implement in their features. I solve problems daily and come up with solutions that makes it easier to develop. I have a strong customer focus and value their user experience. 

I have had a strong focus on utilizing WASM (Web assembly) to solve interesting problems in the last year, and was the first person in Capital One to use WASM+Workers in a production environment on a customer facing product in the front end. 

I am the organizer and host for our internal Hackathon in Refi. This Hackathon has produced more than 40 patents in the last year and we strive to innovate in every Hackathon. I have submitted 4 patents, and successfully filed one with the US patent office. Many of these innovations have made it to production. 

Hosted internal development talks for front end development to audiences of 200+ per talk over many different topics, including: WebAssembly (WASM), WebWorkers and ServiceWorkers, Analyzing Browser Performance with Lighthouse, CSS grid vs Flex and when to use which one, Lit Element, Storybook, ionic framework, Angular, React, unit testing with Jasmine and Jest, automation testing with Cypress.io, and git branching strategies using gitflow and how to correlate it to your environment.

positions.title: Software Engineer Technical Screener
positions.description:
Screened candidates for development roles over the phone, asking questions and determining if they are a good fit for the role based off of criteria set by the hiring managers. 

Screened for UI/Frontend Roles as well as Backend roles (PHP/Node).

Conduct screenings as if they are interviews to prepare the potential candidates for an interview if they were to walk into one. 

Coordinate directly with Account Managers and Recruiters by relaying detailed information about the candidates' screenings that they can pass on to the client.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full Stack Developer --

Backend
* Developing API's in Java 8 and Play Framework on multiple microservices. Also playing with Spring Boot.

* Developing new API in Node/Express/GraphQL to act as a middleware/orchestration layer for current application. 

* Developing and Implementing new Angular Universal Server Side Rendering with a Docker instance that will serve up our Angular application to users more efficiently. 
 
* Developing new APIs that run the current legacy Laravel frontend, and developing/refactoring new endpoints that are for the new Angular 7 frontend. 

* Using Fractal for API development to maintain a consistent response structure that uses jsonapi.org's standards.

* Transforming data for the new frontend to consume.

* Using Object Oriented Principles to create an API using Laravel that is modular and transforming the development into a rapid development environment by creating easy to use, reusable functions and classes that can be used in a versatile way through out the application. 

Frontend
* Resolved major performance hurdles in Angular 5 before moving to Angular 7 by optimizing the way assets are packaged and refactoring code. Took the load time from 15 seconds down to >1 second. 

* Developing new Angular 7 application based on designs from the Design Team that will utilize the new APIs

* Using SCSS and LESS to develop a consistent theme throughout the entire site, making it more maintainable and easier to code. 

* Implemented a card design that took the website from a minimalistic, no-lined design, and made it have more dimension.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · JavaScript · Spring Boot · Web Components

Made design decisions as well as created new UI from the ground up for multiple sections of the site, including making it more mobile friendly and easier to use on many different device sizes.

positions.title: Senior Laravel/Vue Engineer (Consultant)
positions.description: Developed new frontend interface using Semantic UI and BEM principles using Vue.js and Laravel. Made design decisions as well as created new UI from the ground up for multiple sections of the site, including making it more mobile friendly and easier to use on many different device sizes.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed features and maintained the tournaments application that handled payments and registrations of all teams for basketball, football, volleyball, and soccer.
- Managed technical debt with legacy application and completely redesigned the application by dockerizing, namespacing, and implementing PHPUnit to test existing and new code to improve coverage.
- Built new Laravel core and slowly moving the codebase to it to be more supportable and less spaghetti code.
- Implemented CI/CD in GitLab to allow our legacy application to be deployable and more dependent on tests passing.
- Developed new API for the tournament scheduler in NodeJS, Express, and Sequelize, using MySQL for the database and Sequelize as the ORM.
- Worked on moving the legacy PHP application to a more stable Laravel Core and a new Angular 5 Frontend.
- Worked in Docker environments and spun up multiple different environments to handle the different applications
- Onboarded and managed multiple engineers both onsite and remote.
- Point of contact for all things tournaments and payments for the tournaments application.
- Worked in an Agile environment and used JIRA for issue tracking and GitLab for repository storage.

positions.title: Software Engineer Lead
positions.description:
I develop web tools from the front end to the server side code. I develop RESTful APIs and data architectures that use Lumen and Slim in combination with Laravel (a PHP MVC Framework). We use Microsoft's IIS as our web server environment and MSSQL and MySQL for our databases depending on the application.

The skills used are all coding languages necessary to get the job done:
-php7.1/HTML5/custom web programming 
-Bootstrap/Semantic-UI/Foundation
-Angular 2/4 and Angular Material Implementation (when it was in beta)
-Ionic Framework
-SQL Database development 
-Custom java desktop apps (Java 7)
-Custom mobile apps (iOS and Android) as needed
-Objective C, and C++
-SSRS/SSIS Design and implementation of reports and processes

Using MSSQL and MySQL, I integrate and manage data coming in and out of databases in the district. When data is requested, I come up with a solution to compile the data. This could be in SSRS, SSIS, SSMS, a combination of the three, or even developing a mobile or web application that will allow the end user to accomplish what they need.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Analyst
positions.description:
I work as the point of contact and primary auditor of agents that focus on Microsoft Account issues in the Xbox Division. My primary focus for the agents is to help them provide the best possible service and support to the customer, while still upholding business policies and standards. 

The position entails all of the following:
- Auditing agents on a case-by-case basis while focusing on the Quality of Service that was presented to the customer, 
- Writing and defining processes and policies related to the line of business.
- Implementing training modules to help new-hires acclimate themselves to the rapidly changing work environment.
- Identifying specific trends coming in from the customers, and identifying trends and bad habits that agents company-wide are developing.
- Maintaining uniformity to provide the highest level of support possible to the customer.
- Currently the primary contact for adding/removing agents from the Quality Database.
- Provide Side-by-side coaching to all agents and giving weekly Quality reviews to maintain the Quality of Service.
- *Most Important* Advocating for the customer and identifying the issues quickly, before anything gets out of hand.

positions.title: Level 3 Xbox Universal Technical Support
positions.description:
I am the last line of support for all fraudulent activity, unauthorized access, and technical issues related to both the Xbox console and Microsoft accounts from a billing standpoint. 

I have also been acting as floor support for the rest of the agents in the office if they are in need of desk-side assistance or technical support.

positions.title: Help Desk Support
positions.description:
Handled calls related to Point of Sale software and hardware on a Tier 1 and Tier 2 level. 

Software support for ISS45 and IBM 4690 systems. Also supported Windows and Linux based systems and the respective software for each system. Also handled Retalix based fuel software and troubleshooting all aspects of it on a daily basis.

Re-built Windows and IBM servers from the ground-up and implemented/installed them.

Experienced high pressure emergency situations on a daily basis, working at my own pace, but still getting the job done in a timely manner to satisfy the customer.

Worked in a Call Center environment that is constantly changing and each day is never the same as the last. 

Handled network related issues and troubleshooted corporate networks on a daily basis.

Experience with installing and troubleshooting laser printers on all Operating systems.
